advisories.reason: Memory exhaustion in zod 4's $ZodArray (fixed in zod 4.6.6). @x402/core and @x402/evm 2.29.0 use zod 4.6.7, and so does everything that loads zod/v4. The app's wallet libraries (WalletConnect, Reown AppKit, Coinbase CDP SDK) still pin zod 3.22-3.25 and load only the zod 3 root, which does not contain the vulnerable code; ARL code does not import zod. scripts/check-zod.mjs fails CI if any of this changes. Remove when the wallet libraries move to zod >= 4.6.6.
